Title: Illsusions of the kindred and telepathic tracking

Messages.Author: Peter Laan
Messages.Body:
A vampire plays illusions of the kindred and draws francois villon who
enters combat. Can francois play telepathic tracking at superior to start a
new round of combat (when the first round ends)? Searching google showed
that he can't play psyche. But telepathic has slightly different wording.

Illusions of the Kindred
[chi] Combat ends. Move the bottom card of your crypt to your ready region.
He or she does not contest any other vampires or titles in play. The vampire
has an amount of blood equal to half of his or her capacity (round down).
Combat begins between the vampire and the opposing minion. Remove the
vampire from the game **at the end of combat**.

Psyche!
[CEL] Only usable **at the end of a combat** when both combatants are still
ready. Enter combat with the opposing minion. This is a new combat.

Telepathic Tracking
[AUS] Only usable when both combatants are still ready and **combat is about
to end** (with no uncanceled press to continue). Combat does not end;
another round starts.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Peter Laan wrote:
> A vampire plays illusions of the kindred and draws francois villon who
> enters combat. Can francois play telepathic tracking at superior to start a
> new round of combat (when the first round ends)? Searching google showed
> that he can't play psyche. But telepathic has slightly different wording.

Correct. He can, since TT isn't competing to begin a new combat - it is merely
continuing the current combat.

> Illusions of the Kindred
> [chi] Combat ends. Move the bottom card of your crypt to your ready region.
> He or she does not contest any other vampires or titles in play. The vampire
> has an amount of blood equal to half of his or her capacity (round down).
> Combat begins between the vampire and the opposing minion. Remove the
> vampire from the game **at the end of combat**.
>
> Psyche!
> [CEL] Only usable **at the end of a combat** when both combatants are still
> ready. Enter combat with the opposing minion. This is a new combat.
>
> Telepathic Tracking
> [AUS] Only usable when both combatants are still ready and **combat is about
> to end** (with no uncanceled press to continue). Combat does not end;
> another round starts.

continue the Illusionary combat?
